Popeye 2.name: Popeye 2
Popeye 2.summary: Popeye 2 is a 1991 2D platform game, developed by Copya System and published by Sigma Enterprises for the Game Boy handheld. It is a sequel to Popeye, released exclusively in Japan in 1990.

Red Arremer - Makaimura Gaiden.name: Gargoyle's Quest
Red Arremer - Makaimura Gaiden.summary: Gargoyle’s Quest is an action-adventure game in which players control Firebrand, a gargoyle who defends the Ghoul Realm from invading forces known as the Destroyers. The game combines side-scrolling action with exploration elements, allowing the player to use abilities such as flight and fire attacks to progress. Throughout the game, Firebrand collects items that enhance his abilities and aid in combat.
